reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, round-2 fix-verification batch

samples_reviewed.question_text: What number comes next when counting: 0, 10, 20, 30, ___?
What number comes next when counting: 4, 6, 8, 10, ___?
What number comes next when counting: 0, 5, 10, 15, ___?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Samples cover all three required skip counts: by 10s (0,10,20,30->40), by 2s (4,6,8,10->12), and by 5s (0,5,10,15->20), matching 'Count by 2s, 5s and 10s'.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Across seeds 42-46 the batch exercises 2s, 5s and 10s in both mcq and cloze formats rather than repeating one increment.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The 'What number comes next when counting: ...' stem is short and formulaic, fitting Grade 1 Q2 reading ability.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Both mcq (seed 42,43,45,46) and cloze (seed 44) formats are present, showing the registered variants exercise more than one response mode.

competency_alignment.rationale: All samples are pure skip-counting sequences, directly matching the skip_counting_by_2/5/10 concepts this node introduces.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Sequences stay under 40, a sensible entry point within the 'up to 100' ceiling for an early Grade 1 Q2 skip-counting item.
